item.title: Audible Launches AI Audio Discovery Feature for Audiobook Browsing
item.description:
Audible has launched an AI-powered audio discovery feature that generates brief overviews of a book's themes and listener reactions, blended with editor or author commentary pulled from past interviews. The move extends last month's AI tools for character interaction and recaps as Audible faces rising competition in the audiobook market.

item.title: US Tightens AI Chip Export Rules to Close Remote Compute Loophole
item.description:
The US Commerce Department unveiled an interim rule requiring licenses for exporting, reexporting or transferring AI chips and servers to data centers anywhere in the world if they may supply compute to China or other restricted countries. The rule extends controls to remote access, closing a loophole that let restricted-country firms bypass chip export limits via offshore infrastructure, covering the D:5 embargo group including China, Russia, Iran and North Korea.

原文标题：美国收紧 AI 芯片出口管制 封堵远程算力访问

Why it matters：这是算力出口管制从实体芯片向远程访问延伸的关键监管升级，直接影响全球 AI 基础设施布局与跨境算力供给。

The updates launch Monday on Android and iOS, while Ask Maps expands to 30 European countries including Spain, Germany and the UK, marking Google's push to embed agentic task completion into a mass-market consumer service.

item.title: AMD Completes World Labs Acquisition, Appoints Fei-Fei Li as Chief Scientist
item.description:

Fei-Fei Li joins AMD as Executive Vice President and Chief Scientist, reporting directly to Lisa Su, to co-optimize compute platforms with models. The move extends AMD from chip supplier toward full-stack AI infrastructure, directly contesting Nvidia's hardware-software integration strategy.

item.title: Coral Open-Source Agent Gateway Lets Agents Write Their Own Tools
item.description:
Coral is an open-source, self-hosted execution gateway that sits between agents and the systems they operate on. Agents invoke tools by writing short TypeScript programs and persist working code as reusable custom tools, with every call checked against policy before credentials are injected and the request forwarded. The team reports custom tools make agents 29% faster at 31% lower cost on GitHub, Linear and Slack tasks.

原文标题：Coral 开源智能体网关 让智能体自写工具提速 29%

Why it matters：以策略校验加凭证注入的执行网关切入智能体工具自生成，并给出可量化的效率与成本收益，对构建智能体基础设施的开发者有直接参考价值。

item.title: FrontierML Benchmark Shows AI Agents Can Buy Their Own Performance Gains
item.description:
Researchers released FrontierML, a benchmark measuring how well agents convert capital into model performance across 21 end-to-end ML tasks. Each task gives a 12-hour CPU sandbox, a $10 to $200 wallet, and validation samples, and frontier systems already turn that budget into measurable self-improvement. The result highlights advancing AI R&D capability and hints at a machine economy where agents sub-contract work to one another.

原文标题：FrontierML 基准：AI 智能体可花 200 美元自主提升模型性能

Why it matters：首个以“资金转化为模型性能”为核心度量的智能体基准，直接触及 AI 自我改进与机器经济议题。

item.title: CheeseDB Debuts Embedded Agent Memory Database with Revocable Provenance
item.description:
CheeseDB is an embedded database engine purpose-built for AI agent memory, implemented in Go with only the standard library. It uses an append-only, hash-chained store in which every memory tracks its sources, so deleting a source also revokes everything learned from it, addressing bad data, prompt injection and user deletion requests. The project is in preview, has not had an independent security review, and its API and on-disk format may change before v1.0, so it is not yet recommended for production data.

原文标题：CheeseDB 发布可撤销记忆的智能体数据库

Why it matters：来源可撤销的记忆数据库切中智能体记忆污染与数据删除的真实痛点，且以纯 Go 嵌入式形态提供 MCP 接入，具备明确的工程参考价值。

item.description:

IRON stands 178 cm tall with 82 active degrees of freedom, runs on XPeng's in-house Turing AI chip and an end-to-end model, and supports multi-person recognition and identity memory. He cited hardware, scaled manufacturing and high-quality data as the core moat.

Of the 491 models tracked, 481 were released in that window, the top score was beaten on 23 separate days by models from OpenAI, Google DeepMind, SpaceXAI and Anthropic, and GPT-4 Turbo has fallen to 379th place.

item.title: Meta Unveils JiTTests Where LLMs Write Failing Tests to Catch Bugs
item.description:
Meta introduced JiTTests, which has LLMs generate tests expected to fail against a code diff, proving the change altered behavior before it lands; an LLM judge ensemble plus a rule-based filter called RubFake then decides which failures merit engineer attention. In H1 2026 it caught 74 privacy SEVs at the diff stage, cut privacy SEV occurrence by 20%, and drew a roughly 60% engineer-reported true-positive rate across 589 engineers. Intent-aware tests showed a 6.4% weak-catch rate per test versus 0.8% for Meta's earlier ACH hardening, though the initial paper deployment confirmed only 8 of 41 reported catches and all production figures are self-reported.

原文标题：Meta 推出 JiTTests 用大模型生成失败测试拦截缺陷

Why it matters：把大模型从代码评审转向生成可执行的失败测试，是 AI 辅助软件工程中较新的验证范式，且附带真实生产数据与明确的局限说明。

item.title: Alibaba Releases Qwen4-Max 2.4T-Parameter MoE Flagship
item.description:
Alibaba released Qwen4-Max, a 2.4T-parameter sparse MoE flagship that activates only 71B parameters per token at $1.5 per million input tokens. Its rebuilt sparse MoE stack uses three Gated DeltaNet layers to compress history for each Qwen Sparse Attention layer, a lightweight indexer for context selection, plus four gated residual branches and 328B N-gram embedding parameters. It tops 4 of 16 benchmarks but trails Claude Opus 5.5 and Kimi K3.1 on coding and terminal tasks, a clear trade-off.

原文标题：阿里发布 2.4T 参数 Qwen4-Max 旗舰模型

Why it matters：2.4T 参数旗舰模型以极低激活成本发布，稀疏 MoE 架构细节与真实基准取舍对模型选型有直接参考价值。

item.title: IMF Warns AI Circular Financing Tops $1 Trillion as Growth Hinges on AI
item.description:
IMF Managing Director Kristalina Georgieva warned that the global economy is leaning on AI as its single growth engine, with circular financing among AI firms now exceeding $1 trillion, roughly two-thirds of it debt-funded. She called recent volatility an orderly adjustment but cautioned that if AI disappoints expectations, US equities could fall 20% in 2026 and global output could run 1.1% below baseline by 2028.

原文标题：IMF 警告 AI 循环融资规模已超 1 万亿美元

Why it matters：IMF 首次给出 AI 循环融资超万亿美元的量级估算，是判断 AI 资本泡沫风险的关键宏观信号。

item.title: S2 Ditches Route53 for Self-Hosted Authoritative DNS to Scale Unlimited Basins
item.description:

To support unlimited per-account basins, each mapped to its own subdomain and CNAME record, the team needed strongly consistent, unbounded DNS record management and ultimately went self-hosted; customers now create thousands of basins that are instantly available for streaming.

原文标题：S2 弃用 Route53 自建权威 DNS 支撑无限存储桶
